items.name: Nordic Championship 2018

venue.name: [Tångahallen](http://www.tangahed.se)
venue.details: Main events will be in the big indoor football field. Side events take place in a bowling hall close to the main hall.

items.information:
This competition will be the first edition of a Nordic Championship! 

**Citizens of Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, and Sweden are eligible for prizes and the (unofficial) titles for this championship.** The competition is still open to citizens of every country.

Please be sure to read all the tabs and regularly check your email leading up to this competition!

Remember to check your email, there will be an email sent out a few days before the competition will take place. It will contain some more detailed information about the competition.
